asset_authoring.animation.title: Asset authoring: animation

task_refs.description: Create core skeletal animation assets from an engine skeleton, edit sequence/blendspace settings, save, and inspect sequence/blendspace/ABP metadata

Create a Chooser Table, add a bool predicate column, select a Texture2D result row, edit the cell, save, and inspect rows/cells
Create a Chooser Table row that selects one Texture2D, rewrite the result asset reference to another Texture2D, save, and inspect the compiled chooser
Create a Chooser Table with an asset result, duplicate the chooser tree with remap rules, save, and inspect the duplicate's remapped result reference
Create a PoseSearch schema/database, add and edit an animation database entry, save, and read database metadata back
Create BlendSpace1D and AimOffset1D assets, edit their axes, save, and inspect axis metadata
Create an AnimComposite with a sequence segment and a MirrorDataTable from the same skeleton, save both, and inspect metadata
Create an AnimSequence, duplicate it, edit root-motion and additive settings on the duplicate, save, and read sequence metadata back
Create a PoseSearch NormalizationSet, attach a database to it, assign it back to the database, save both assets, and read the normalization reference back
Create a Chooser Table with a class context entry, retarget the context object class, save, and inspect/validate the new context class
Create an AnimBlueprint, build a locomotion state machine, add a follow-up state and transition, save it, and read the authored state graph back
Create PoseSearch assets and an AnimBlueprint, wire Motion Matching plus Pose History into the AnimGraph output, save it, and verify the output pose is driven
Create a source AnimSequence, build a montage from a section spec in one action, save it, and inspect section flow and blend settings
Create an AnimSequence, add two point notifies, remove one by returned index, save, and read back the remaining notify
Create an AnimSequence, add a state notify, edit its time, duration, and reflected state properties, save, and read back the state notify interval
Create a BlendSpace with three samples, edit one sample's position and animation, save it, and verify the edited sample data
Create an AnimSequence, capture a valid skeleton bone name, write transform keys to that bone track, save, and read the keyed transforms back
Create a BlendSpace, edit its interpolation mode and triangulation preference, save it, and verify authored interpolation metadata
Create an AnimMontage, add and rename a slot, edit blend timings, save it, and verify slot plus blend metadata
Create an IKRig asset, add and remove a solver stack entry, save it, and verify the solver stack read-back
Create an AnimSequence, add curve and sync-marker metadata, rename the marker, remove both authored items, save, and verify cleanup
Create an AnimSequence directly from per-frame bone pose data, save it, and read the generated frame rate and bone-track keys back
